content_data.meeting_title: Aerospace Accessibility Initiative: Phase I Review and Future Directions
agenda_items: Evaluation of proposed curriculum modifications for inclusive design principles
Review of current university accessibility audit findings for aerospace engineering labs
Strategic planning for external partnerships with aerospace industry accessibility groups
Allocation of resources for next phase of research and development
Discussion on preliminary results from assistive technology integration pilot
key_decisions: Initiate formal discussions with SpaceTech Innovations regarding collaborative research on haptic feedback systems for visually impaired pilots
Prioritize procurement of specialized accessible equipment for propulsion research lab within the next month
Formulate a working group to develop a standardized accessibility assessment framework for all university facilities by the next quarter
Approve the integration of 'Human Factors in Accessible Aerospace Systems' module into the graduate curriculum starting the next academic cycle
action_items: Dr. Anya Sharma: Prepare detailed report on assistive technology pilot outcomes for review by end of next week
Professor Kenji Tanaka: Draft proposal for curriculum revision to include inclusive design principles, due in two weeks
Dr. Samuel Adebayo: Schedule follow-up meeting with university procurement for specialized equipment acquisition, within the next five business days
Dr. Lena Petrova: Research and compile a list of potential aerospace industry partners focused on accessibility, due in one month
